name: 白砚 · 金铃剑狐
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent 2.5D action RPG companion animation atlas, not a concept poster. Original sophisticated Chinese xianxia fantasy art, hand-painted physically credible animal materials with detailed individual fur/scales/wing veins. Small graceful spirit companion, attractive and refined, never juvenile cartoon. Orthographic 3/4 side view looking RIGHT, camera above about 25 degrees. Entire creature visible in every frame, consistent anatomy, SAME SIZE and EXACT SAME FOOTLINE / float center in all frames. A strict regular 4 columns x 4 rows atlas of exactly 16 isolated frames. 16 identical square cells on a transparent canvas. Each figure MUST stay inside the central 70% of its own cell, leaving at least 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT GUTTER on ALL FOUR SIDES, even effects. Absolutely no overlap, no touching edges, no continuous line or effect between cells. Frame center x=50%, feet baseline y=82%. Row1 4 idle frames. Row2 4 locomotion frames. Row3 4 attack frames. Row4 4 support-cast frames. Each row a smooth coherent action, no new anatomy. Transparent background including every gutter, no floor, no shadow, no grid, no labels, no text, no UI, no watermarks. Cool neutral light from upper left, authentic rich surface detail. Small local elemental accents only, never massive circles or fog that hide the body. All frames have a full uncropped tail/wing/antler. 
Character identity: 白砚 · 金铃剑狐. an adult silver-white spiritual fox, long anatomically elegant body, fine narrow muzzle, normal small amber eyes, long pointed ears with fine inner hairs, flowing full tail with gold-tipped guard hairs. Delicate antique-gold etched forehead mark and small suspended sword-bell clasp at throat, not armour. Thin gold blade motif along the back fur. Noble, quick, intelligent, approachable.
Animation requirements: idle: soft breathing, one slow blink, ears tilt, tail tip sways. run: true four-leg fox trot with alternating support, tail counterbalance. attack: low forward lunge and fine gold sword shard from mouth. cast: poised lifted forepaw, three thin golden sword feathers in front.
